reviews.text: They have a bird daycare service. This summer my lovebird was in their care for almost four weeks and was very happy. When I picked him up, he was doing great; his feathers were even shinier, and the cage was perfect. The young man who helped me was very kind. I plan to go back. It's a bit on the other side of town from where I live, but it's worth it.
We went this afternoon to get information about "adopting" a gecko and Mireia attended to us and gave us excellent information
Pet supply and accessories store in the neighborhood. Great service and they'll advise you on the best option for your needs.
I drop off the packages and they ship them to me. I also receive packages, and even though the coverage is bad, the service is very good if you're from the neighborhood.
It's really great, the prices are very good and they have everything. I'd never been before and I recommend it 100%.

This time I'm giving it one star because I bought goldfish 🐠🐟 along with another species that I was told could live together, but it turns out those other fish started eating the goldfish. Because of this, the tank became contaminated and the goldfish ended up dying, which is very unfortunate. I went to see if they would take responsibility, but they said that this could happen.
They took perfect care of our pet.
He won't leave a package at this location! I left my package here, and the store employee lost or stole it. There's no tracking information. And he refuses to fix it.
A very friendly and knowledgeable young man served me, offering recommendations and good prices compared to most places.

Everything was fine, I live very far away, I came wanting to buy a turtle, but since they didn't have any, the worker recommended I go to another one that was 12 minutes away, and when I arrived, they told me they didn't have any either.
It's our favorite store! We always buy everything from them.

We were browsing the shop with some friends, looking to buy a hamster for a friend, when we saw an open room with a lizard. They closed the door on us very rudely, and we thought they were being unfriendly. They practically kicked us out of the shop, and we just wanted to be nice.

I didn't like this shop at all; I won't be back.
Prices are outrageously high… 20-30% more expensive than in other stores. Plus, there's not enough space for so much product. Prices are missing…
Both the shop and the vet were very attentive. The shop has everything and is cheaper than other places, and in my case, I'm very happy with how they treat and care for me.
The vet is very attentive and friendly and explains things very well.
